code.description:
A stable code to branch on:

- `unreadable_request`: no task or conversation could be read from `body`, so the default is proposed
- `router_unavailable`: the router model didn't answer, so the default is proposed
- `label_mismatch`: the router model can't score some of the router's models, so the default is proposed
- `context_exceeds_models`: the request is longer than every model's context window; the default is proposed, but its provider will likely refuse it
- `no_session`: the request continues a conversation but no session id was found, so routing can't tell which model's cache is warm

message.example: This request continues a conversation, but no session id was found in `session_id` or `headers`, so routing can't see which model's cache is warm.
